title: Ashmorrow launcher manifest
description: What the launcher is told about a realm, a client build, and Ashmorrow's own patches. launcher/core/src/manifest.rs is the authority and enforces more than this file can express; this schema exists so the document can be validated in CI and by anything that is not Rust.

$comment.description: Prose for whoever edits the file. Ignored by every reader.

schema.description: Bumped when a change would make an older launcher misread this document.

address.description: What goes into realmlist.wtf. A hostname or an IP, never a URL.

measured_from.description: Where these hashes were measured, so a player can judge whether 'differs from known-good' means anything for their copy.

runtime.description: Free software the launcher installs into its OWN Wine prefix so a Linux player does not have to assemble a runtime by hand. Not ours and not Blizzard's; the distinction that lets these carry a URL is that they are third-party free software we are entitled to redistribute.

relativePath.description: Relative to the client root, / separated. The Rust validator additionally rejects any . or .. component and any drive prefix; this pattern catches the cheap cases.

clientFile.description: A file belonging to Blizzard. Facts only: a path, a size and a hash. There is deliberately no field in which a download location could be written, and additionalProperties is false so that adding one is an error rather than something quietly ignored. See docs/decisions/0005-client-distribution.md, rules 1 and 4.

patch.description: A file Ashmorrow wrote. The only kind of entry that may name a location, because it is the only kind of file this launcher is allowed to fetch.

runtimeComponent.description: A third-party free-software component. Same two invariants as a patch: an https URL, and a hash checked before anything is written.

kind.description: How the installer should unpack it.

licence.description: Recorded so a release can state it.

^\\$comment.description: Prose for whoever edits the file. Ignored by every reader.
